export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records (https://importkey.com/countries/india/srishti-wool-combers), counter: "Total Shipments 547 Records detected", "Trading Partners 20", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-26"; rows actually seen in the free view: 5 shipment rows. Export rows quoted verbatim: "2026-02-24 | SRISHTI WOOL COMBERS | TO ORDER | WOOL WORSTED YARN- RWS DYED WORSTED YARN(LOT NO. 2506)- | GRFL SAHNEWAL LUDHIANA ICD INSGF6, India | Genoa, ITALY | 51071010 | 9975749"; "2026-02-16 | SRISHTI WOOL COMBERS | TO ORDER | WOOL TOPS- WOOL TOP (LOT NO.1441)- | GRFL SAHNEWAL LUDHIANA ICD INSGF6, India | Klaipeda, LITHUANIA | 51052910 | 9700781"; "2026-02-07 | SRISHTI WOOL COMBERS | TO ORDER | WOOL TOPS- OPEN WOOL TOPS (LOT NO. 9518)- | HTPL ICD KILARAIPUR INQRH6, India | Constanta, ROMANIA | 51052910 | 9456753". So: dated export bills of lading with destination (Italy, Lithuania, Romania) and HS codes 51071010 / 51052910.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or annual-report split found in the sources read. ImportKey shows only customs (cross-border) records; the domestic leg is visible only indirectly via the named Indian consignee/notify parties "GRFL SAHNEWAL LUDHIANA ICD" and "HTPL ICD KILARAIPUR", which are inland container depots, not proof of domestic sales. Domestic supply: not public in the sources checked — null.
note: Actual shipments confirmed, not just claims: 547 customs records on ImportKey with the latest dated 2026-02-26, and three dated export B/Ls (9975749 to Genoa/Italy, 9700781 to Klaipeda/Lithuania, 9456753 to Constanta/Romania) for wool tops and worsted yarn. The company is also a large importer of raw greasy wool — e.g. "2026-02-21 | KEN-KNIT (KENYA) LTD | SRISHTI WOOL COMBERS | RAW WOOL (CARPET GRADE 19.5 MICRON ABOVE) (NOT CARDED OR COMBED) | Mombasa, Kenya | MUNDRA SEA INMUN1, India | 51011900 | 7677322" — i.e. a combing/processing operation importing greasy wool and exporting combed tops/yarn, which fits the declared HS 510720 (wool tops/combed wool) family; the observed export codes are 51071010 and 51052910, so the declared 510720 is close but not identical to the seen lines. Declared industry "Продукты питания и FMCG" is wrong — this is a wool textile processor, not food/FMCG; per project rules this is not a rejection ground, the industry/HS should simply be corrected. Caveats: web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) and volza returned HTTP 403, so no second independent source was read; the 547 figure is the site's own counter versus 5 rows actually visible, and the free view does not let me separate export from import counts. Domestic GST turnover and any GeM/CPPP participation are not public in what I could read — recorded as null, not estimated.
